podcast.body: The title track from her 1984 album, this song's lyrics were among those that truly established Madonna as a combatant, feminist, and explicit artist, marking the beginning of her provocative image. "Ya empiezan a tener esas letras, tenemos el Like A Berying."

One of three top-ten hits for Madonna in 1984, this song played a significant role in establishing her as a prominent figure in pop music. "She scored only three top ten hits that year, with Borderline, Lucky Star, and like a Virgin."

podcast.body: This title track from her second album was debuted by Madonna at the first MTV Video Music Awards in September 1984, where she appeared in a disheveled bridal gown. It quickly cracked the top five and became her first number one hit a week later, spending six weeks at the top through January 1985. "And a week later, it became Madonna's first number one hit. It would spend six weeks at number one, through January 1985."
